events.text: Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.
"'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke."
"I marry the Lord of Ashbury."
Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.
"And so you shall."
"Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown..."
"...the title is mine."
Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.
"And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes."
"Her shadow still hangs over this house."
Tight close-up of Rupert's face as a sinister grin spreads across his features.
"Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled."
"They call it a wasting of the lungs."
Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.
"How tragic. The slow, quiet decline."
"How much longer can the frail thing survive?"
Medium profile of Rupert looking out the window, hands clasped behind him.
"Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort."
Close-up of Catherine turning her head toward the window, her lips curled in venomous disgust.
"Good. The village is already whispering about her."
"The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes."
"They disgust me."
Medium two-shot. Rupert stands over Catherine seated at the polished table, placing a gloved hand possessively near her shoulder.
"They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots."
"They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown."

Medium close-up tilting down on JULIANA kneeling in the straw beside a rustic wooden crate, sorting sprigs of dried lavender and sage into a woven basket. Her hands are bound in linen bandages from the recent fire.
The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.
"Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana."
"Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft."
Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.
"If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins."

promos.hook: Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.
promos.cliffhanger: "If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins."
promos.open_question: Will Juliana's resolve stop the valley's lung fever?
promos.rationale: Hook presents Catherine's cold dismissal; coherence conveys clear power struggle; cliffhanger ends with unresolved threat to the valley.

events.text: Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.
"She saved me!"
Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.
"Your Grace..."
Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.
"I know what happened to me!"
Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.
"I was poisoned!"
"And you... you knew!"
Wide shot as Juliana lunges across the room toward the bed, but the armed guard seizes her from behind and drags her back.
"Let me help her!"
"She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!"
Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.
"You see?"
"The poison has clearly damaged her mind."
Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.
"I am not delusional!"
"Of course you are not."
"You are merely confused."
Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.
"How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists..."
"...is the maid who claims to have discovered it."
Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.
"Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house."
Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.
Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

promos.cliffhanger: "Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house."
promos.open_question: Will the maid’s poisoned evidence expose the true culprit, or will Catherine’s scheming silence it?
promos.rationale: Hook presents a dramatic accusation; cliffhanger ends on a guard’s order to remove Juliana, leaving the poison’s truth unknown; audience sees Dowager seeking justice and Catherine manipulating power, matching betrayal‑poison tropes; omitted middle shots impair visual continuity.

events.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's gaze locking onto Juliana's tearful eyes.
"You are my wife."
Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.
"You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that."
High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in her disheveled burgundy gown, clutching her skirts and weeping profusely.
"I have nowhere to go, Your Grace."
Low-angle shot tracking Catherine clutching her chest in agony.
"London closed its doors! My family disowned me!"
Medium close-up of Lady Ashbourne, her gloved hand resting on her cane as she delivers her cold judgment.
"She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road."
Medium shot of Vaughn drawing his baton, ready to seize Catherine from behind.
"One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates."
Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.
"Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!"
Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.
"Please, Alexander! Have mercy!"
Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.
"Stop."
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.

promos.hook: Tight close-up on Alexander's gaze locking onto Juliana's tearful eyes.
promos.cliffhanger: Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.
promos.rationale: Hook features Alexander’s claim of marriage; cliffhanger ends on his shocked turn, leaving Catherine’s punishment unclear. Coherence solid, trope fits romance‑power conflict. Stitch low due to many omitted cameras.

"Catherine knew!"

promos.cliffhanger: Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

events.text: Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.
The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.
Medium close-up of Gerald turning frantically to the remaining guards and congregation, panicking.
"What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!"
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.
Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.
"Are you hurt?"
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes her head gently, overwhelmed with wonder.
Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.
Close-up profile of The Bearded Stranger casting a sharp, menacing glance toward the other guard.
"Good. Then don't touch her again."
Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch shrieking in exasperation from the altar steps.
"You cannot interfere in a family matter!"
Close-up of Juliana's elderly father looking down, gripping his hands nervously with profound guilt.
"I can..."
Medium shot of guests in the pews whispering and reacting in hushed shock.
"...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church."
Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger and Lady Juliana framed against the illuminated stained-glass rose window.
"You shouldn't have to beg anybody..."
Close-up on Juliana looking up into his eyes, moved to the core.
"...to remember your worth."
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's rugged, bearded face looking down at her with tender reverence.
Close-up on Juliana, her lips parting in quiet astonishment.
"Why are you doing this?"
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger, completely unfazed.
"Because I want to."
Close-up on Juliana's father wringing his gold ring, eyes heavy with regret.
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger slipping his hand into his coat pocket.
Close-up of Juliana watching him with rapt, trembling anticipation.
Extreme close-up of The Bearded Stranger's rugged fingers holding up a simple, polished silver band.
"You came here to become a wife."
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger extending the ring toward Juliana.
"They took that from you."
Over-the-shoulder medium shot past The Bearded Stranger onto Gerald standing petrified and humiliated in the aisle.
Medium close-up on The Bearded Stranger presenting the ring directly to Juliana.
"I am offering it back."
Close-up on Juliana glancing down at the ring, breathless and overwhelmed.
"You don't even know me."
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's warm, piercing gaze.
"I know enough."
Full wide profile shot as The Bearded Stranger slowly and respectfully drops onto one knee before Lady Juliana.
The Bearded Stranger sinks to one knee on the cathedral aisle, offering the silver ring up to Juliana.
A collective, stunned gasp rippling across the entire congregation.
Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch, Gerald, and the Lady in Gold Gown frozen in sheer, jaw-dropped bewilderment.
Low-angle medium close-up of The Bearded Stranger on his knee, holding the silver ring high with steady dignity.
"Lady Juliana... accept my hand."

promos.hook: Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.
promos.open_question: Will Lady Juliana accept his hand?
promos.rationale: The opening guard‑vs‑stranger clash instantly grabs attention. The narrative shows the stranger protecting Juliana, but motivations are only implied, limiting clarity. The final proposal creates a clear unresolved question, fitting a heroic‑rescue trope. Continuous footage needs no stitching.

events.text: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.
"Why isn't it working?"
Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.
"Wait."
Close-up of the sleeping boy as beads of sweat form on his forehead, his breathing deepening.
Close-up of the mother gently caressing her son's cheek, sobbing with relief.
"His fever... it's breaking."
Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.
Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.
"You saved him."
Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.
"The herbs did their work. Let him rest."
Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.
"I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you."
The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.
"You cannot let the whole village start talking about you."
Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.
"A child's life matters more than gossip."
Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.
"Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous."
Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.
"Then we will face it together."
Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.
The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.
"What is it?"
Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.
"There is a rumor going around, my Lord."
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.
"What rumor?"
Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.
"About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke."
Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.
"People see ghosts whenever they want a story."
Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.
"The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war."
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.
"Where?"

promos.rationale: Early dialogue shows urgent problem (mother’s sick child) creating tension; later the nobleman's demand "Where?" leaves the rumor’s source unresolved. Viewer lacks clear who wants what beyond the mother and Juliana, reducing coherence.

events.text: Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.
Tight close-up on Alexander's piercing blue-grey eyes, unwavering and hardened by years of exile.
"While the world mourned a dead heir."
Close-up on his mother's sorrowful gaze lifting toward him.
"And I mourned you."
Medium shot of Alexander looking down, his harsh features softening momentarily with sorrow.
"I know."
Medium close-up on his mother bowing her head toward the rustic tabletop, weeping in utter despair.
"I trusted them."
Wide shot as Alexander stands tall beside the weeping mother seated at the table.
"You trusted family."
Profile close-up of Alexander stepping closer to the door, staring out into the falling snow.
"They used that trust against you."
Alexander steps back toward the table, leaning in urgently toward his mother.
"Mother... Juliana..."
Medium close-up on Alexander leaning both hands on the table, desperate for answers.
"She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back."
Tight close-up on Alexander's strained, furrowed brow.
"I thought perhaps she stayed with you."
Close-up of his mother looking up at him, agony and hesitation washing over her face.
"Alexander..."
Quick push-in close-up on Alexander, his eyes snapping open in sudden panic.
"What?"
Close-up on his mother, tears shining in the amber lamplight.
"She did come to me."
Medium two-shot as Alexander bends over the table, crowding his mother with fierce desperation.
"Is she still at Ashbourne?"
Close-up on Alexander's mother shutting her eyes and weeping, shaking her head in deep anguish.
Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.

promos.hook: Tight close-up on Alexander's piercing blue-grey eyes, unwavering and hardened by years of exile.
promos.open_question: Will Alexander ever discover his mother's fate and rescue her?
promos.rationale: Hook is a tight close‑up of Alexander's eyes within the first seconds, establishing intrigue. Dialogue makes clear Alexander seeks his mother at Ashbourne, giving coherence. No unresolved, consequential question appears at the end, so cliffhanger is weak. Trope of lost heir fits. Continuous clip gives perfect stitch legibility.

events.text: Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.
"Why?!"
Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.
"Because we know who he is."
Medium shot of Catherine clutching her father's arm, her bridal bouquet drooping as panic seizes her face.
"Rupert..."
Medium close-up of Rupert gripping the edge of a pew for balance, his eyes wild with terror.
"You cannot be him. Alexander died!"
Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.
"And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."
Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.
"Alexander..."
Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.
"Mother."
His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.
"Look at you... my beautiful boy."
Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.
"I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be."
"I have come home, Mother."
Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.
"Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!"

promos.cliffhanger: "Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!"
promos.open_question: Will Alexander's claim as the rightful Duke be accepted?
promos.rationale: Hook is the frantic "Why?!" line at the start, grabbing attention. Dialogue reveals Alexander's return and his mother's emotional acceptance, providing coherence. The ending declares his claim without leaving a consequential question, so cliffhanger is weak. Fits resurrection‑heir trope. Continuous format ensures seamless stitching.

events.text: Close-up profile of Alexander as Juliana reaches out her trembling hand to touch his bearded cheek and jawline.
Medium shot as Alexander stands up and drapes a heavy crimson ducal mantle lined with ermine over Juliana's shoulders.
Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.
"You're the Duke?"
Close-up on Alexander looking intensely into her eyes.
"Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton."
Close-up on Juliana, tears of awe spilling over her cheeks.
"All this time?"
Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.
"You chose me when you believed I was nobody."
Medium shot framed between them as Alexander holds her face with both hands, the crowd watching in stunned silence.
"I chose you because you had honor."
Tight close-up on Alexander looking deep into Juliana's blue eyes.
"And I chose you because you saw the man before the title."
Extreme close-up as Alexander and Juliana rest their foreheads and noses together in an intimate embrace.
Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.
"I loved you before I ever knew who you were."
"And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you."
Medium shot as Alexander turns back toward the altar, where Catherine stands in her disheveled wedding gown.
Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.

promos.hook: Close-up profile of Alexander as Juliana reaches out her trembling hand to touch his bearded cheek and jawline.
promos.cliffhanger: Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.
promos.rationale: Hook shows intimate reveal of Alexander as duke early; cliffhanger leaves Catherine’s fate unresolved. Coherence low because viewer isn’t told what each character ultimately wants beyond love.

events.text: Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.
"Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
Close-up of Juliana, her chin lifting with dignified sorrow and quiet defiance.
"Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor."
Medium tracking down Juliana's apron to her hand as she rests it against the bed linens, revealing a distinctive engraved signet ring on her finger.
Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
A sharp, stunned gasp.
Extreme close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping sharply, her eyes widening in profound shock as all color drains from her face.
The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.
Medium shot of the Duchess pushing herself up against the headboard, trembling as she stretches out her frail hand.
"Your hand... Let me see your hand."
Close-up of Juliana reacting with confusion and growing concern at the elder woman's sudden frenzy.
"Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost."
Close-up shot of the Duchess's withered, shaking hand reaching across the blanket toward Juliana's arm.
The Duchess reaches outward with trembling fingers, grasping frantically for Juliana.
A sudden sharp rustle of fabric as her fingers snap tight.
Tight shot of the Duchess's frail hand clamping down with fierce, unexpected strength onto Juliana's dark sleeve.
"Do not move!"
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess looking up at Juliana with overwhelming urgency and tears brimming in her wide eyes.
"Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!"

promos.hook: "Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
promos.cliffhanger: "Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!"
promos.open_question: Who gave Juliana the mysterious ring and why?
promos.rationale: Early dialogue asks why a noble girl works as a maid (hook). Viewer learns the Duchess wants the ring but lacks clear motive, reducing coherence. The Duchess’s demand for the ring’s origin leaves the conflict unresolved (cliffhanger). Continuous format gives perfect stitch legibility.

events.text: Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest.
A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.
"Your Grace."
Medium close-up of Alexander turning toward his operative, his eyes dark with calculating authority.
"Tell me what is happening in Ashburg."
"Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff."
Slow push-in on Alexander's rugged, scarred face, his jaw tightening with simmering rage as he listens.
"Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him."
Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.
"And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess."
Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.
"But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned."
Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.
"There are almost no loyal servants left around her."
Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.
"The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced."
Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.
"My mother is a prisoner in her own house."
Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.
"And everyone believes you are dead."
Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.
"Then let them believe it a little longer."
"And when we have the proof?"
Dramatic low-angle push-in on Alexander's commanding silhouette, his combat scar etched sharply against the fog.

promos.hook: Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest. / A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.
promos.rationale: Intro shows a secretive informant meeting Alexander, establishing intrigue but no immediate hook. Narrative clarity is decent, yet the clip ends without a compelling unresolved question, limiting cliffhanger impact.

events.text: Close-up on Lady Juliana clutching the wash bucket, her eyes scanning ahead urgently.
"Where is the West Wing?"
Medium shot of Prudence pointing toward the archway leading toward the grand staircase.
"Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there."
Tracking shot from behind Lady Juliana as she walks out into the vast, opulent marble hall of Ashbury Manor carrying her bucket.
Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.
Low-angle push-in on Lady Juliana looking up at the enormous portrait of the late Duke and Duchess hanging above the gallery.
"This house..."
Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
Medium close-up of Prudence whispering frantically into Juliana's ear.
"Do not stare. Keep walking."
Wide tracking shot behind Lady Juliana as she hastens down the long marble gallery toward the secluded West Wing wing.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing outside a massive carved mahogany door, glancing around the empty hallway to ensure she is unobserved.
Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
Close-up of Lady Juliana's hand twisting the latch handle.
Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.
Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.
